title: Intel's Lip-Bu Tan has spoken with Lisa Su about potential collaboration with AMD
content: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan has reportedly discussed potential areas of cooperation with AMD chief Lisa Su as Intel works to rebuild its CPU business and expand its foundry operations. The companies have already collaborated on x86 standards and CPU software, including AMD’s integration of its ZenDNN optimizations into Intel’s oneDNN library. Neither executive has publicly detailed the reported discussions or confirmed a new agreement.

title: Interview: From afterthought to bottleneck, circuit boards move to the heart of AI hardware
content: In the era of AI and high-performance computing (HPC), the once-separate worlds of chip design, packaging, and circuit boards are converging. According to the Global Electronics Association, AI server motherboards have become the largest, thickest, and most structurally complex PCBs ever manufactured, drawing substrate and PCB makers, which historically reacted to decisions made by chipmakers and packaging clients, into the heart of AI hardware development.
